crescimento-intercensitario-2010-2022.name: Population growth between the 2010 and 2022 censuses
crescimento-intercensitario-2010-2022.definition: Cumulative percentage change in resident population between the 2010 and 2022 censuses.
crescimento-intercensitario-2010-2022.limitations: Cumulative change over 12 years, not an annual rate or a current population estimate.
crescimento-intercensitario-2010-2022.revisions: First prepared for inclusion on October 23, 2026; not yet published.

populacao-homens-2022.name: Resident population — men
populacao-homens-2022.method: Count published in Table 1 of the SES-SP municipal report based on IBGE census data.
populacao-homens-2022.limitations: Sex classification according to the census, not a measure of gender identity.
populacao-homens-2022.revisions: First prepared for inclusion on October 23, 2026; not yet published.

populacao-mulheres-2022.name: Resident population — women
populacao-mulheres-2022.method: Count published in Table 1 of the SES-SP municipal report based on IBGE census data.
populacao-mulheres-2022.limitations: Sex classification according to the census, not a measure of gender identity.
populacao-mulheres-2022.revisions: First prepared for inclusion on October 23, 2026; not yet published.

populacao-0-14-anos-2022.name: Population aged 0–14
populacao-0-14-anos-2022.definition: Number of residents aged 0 to 14 inclusive.
populacao-0-14-anos-2022.method: Sum of age bands 0–4, 5–9 and 10–14 in Table 1 of the SES-SP report.
populacao-0-14-anos-2022.limitations: An OES aggregate derived from the 2022 census age categories.
populacao-0-14-anos-2022.revisions: First prepared for inclusion on October 23, 2026; not yet published.

populacao-15-64-anos-2022.name: Population aged 15–64
populacao-15-64-anos-2022.definition: Number of residents aged 15 to 64 inclusive.
populacao-15-64-anos-2022.method: Sum of ten five-year age groups, from 15–19 through 60–64.
populacao-15-64-anos-2022.limitations: This age group is not the labor force or employed population.
populacao-15-64-anos-2022.revisions: First prepared for inclusion on October 23, 2026; not yet published.

populacao-65-mais-2022.name: Population aged 65 and over
populacao-65-mais-2022.definition: Number of residents aged 65 or over.
populacao-65-mais-2022.method: Sum of census age bands from 65–69 through 100 and over.
populacao-65-mais-2022.limitations: Uses a 65+ cutoff, not alternative definitions such as 60+.
populacao-65-mais-2022.revisions: First prepared for inclusion on October 23, 2026; not yet published.

taxa-alfabetizacao-15-mais-2022.name: Literacy rate — population aged 15+
taxa-alfabetizacao-15-mais-2022.definition: Share of residents aged 15 or over who can read and write a simple note.
taxa-alfabetizacao-15-mais-2022.method: 216,905 literate persons divided by 216,905 + 7,869, multiplied by 100 and rounded to one decimal place.
taxa-alfabetizacao-15-mais-2022.limitations: Reproduced from IBGE figures in an SES-SP report; the original report file is not archived in the OES.
taxa-alfabetizacao-15-mais-2022.revisions: First prepared for inclusion on October 23, 2026; not yet published.

densidade-demografica-2022.name: Population density — 2022 Census
densidade-demografica-2022.definition: Number of residents per square kilometer.
densidade-demografica-2022.method: Official density published by IBGE for Sumaré's 2022 Census, without mixing land-area reference years.
densidade-demografica-2022.limitations: Uses the land area applied in the 2022 Census publication.
densidade-demografica-2022.revisions: First prepared for inclusion on October 23, 2026; not yet published.

residentes-conta-propria-2022.name: Self-employed residents without employees
residentes-conta-propria-2022.definition: Residents aged 14 or over working on their own account, without employees, in the 2022 Census reference week.
residentes-conta-propria-2022.method: SIDRA table 10261, variable 4090, occupation code 79378, municipality 3552403, all sexes and racial groups.
residentes-conta-propria-2022.limitations: Residents, not local jobs or unique legal entities; includes workers with and without registered businesses.
residentes-conta-propria-2022.revisions: First prepared for inclusion on October 23, 2026; not yet published.

pib-municipal-2023.name: Municipal GDP at current prices
pib-municipal-2023.definition: Municipal gross domestic product at current prices, comprising gross value added and net taxes on products.
pib-municipal-2023.method: SIDRA table 5938, variable 37; source value in thousands of reais multiplied by 1,000.
pib-municipal-2023.limitations: Local output, not residents' personal income; nominal rather than inflation-adjusted.
pib-municipal-2023.revisions: First prepared for inclusion on October 23, 2026; not yet published.
